verdict.rationale: Base44 supports GitHub sync for local development, which provides some version-control capability for app code, but there is no documented feature for versioning/reviewing/rolling back automations specifically (AI agents, workflows, or data changes) within the platform itself. missing for 10: automation-specific versioning, in-app diff/review UI for automations, rollback mechanism for workflow or agent changes, independent confirmation of rollback working in practice.
